title: [Core] Support both DocString and DataTable arguments on steps
description:
### 🤔 What's changed?

It is now possible write step definitions steps that use both data tables and doc strings. For example:

```feature
Feature: Data Tables and Doc Strings

  Steps can have both Data Table and Doc String as arguments at the same time

  Scenario: DataTable followed by DocString
    Given a step with a data table a doc string
      | hello |
      """
      world
      """

  Scenario: DocString followed by DataTable
    Given a step with a doc string a data table
      """
      hello
      """
      | world |
```

Note: Not all formatters will render this correctly.

### ⚡️ What's your motivation? 

Contribute to https://github.com/cucumber/common/issues/2315.

### 🏷️ What kind of change is this?

- :zap: New feature (non-breaking change which adds new behaviour)

bugs.summary: StepExpression.match appends the step's doc string / data table arguments after the cucumber-expression arguments, but creates each with index i counted from 0 within the step arguments instead of offset by the number of expression arguments. The index selects the step definition parameter type used for conversion, so a doc string or data table is converted to the type of the first expression parameter instead of its own parameter.
bugs.trigger: A step definition with at least one expression parameter plus a doc string or data table, e.g. @Given("var {word}=") setVar(String name, StringBuilder value) with a custom @DocStringType: the doc string is converted for parameter 0 (String), so the custom type is ignored and invoking the step fails, or a DocString/DataTable parameter receives the wrong type.
